text: The purpose of this report is to provide an update on the 2023 budget.

The TO Live - Finance and Audit Committee recommends that the Board of Directors of TO Live: 1. Approve the updated 2023 Operating Budget, based on a reduced City investment now totalling $6.172 Million, as set out in Attachment 1 to the report (February 1, 2023) from the President and Chief Executive Officer, TO Live.
